criteria.conditions: Neutral packages only; no platform imports.
criteria.target: Core capability contracts depend on no product, provider, channel, or framework package.
criteria.validity_notes: Must be current for the final functional candidate.

criteria.target: Descriptor data and executable implementation are separate; descriptors never expose handlers.
criteria.validity_notes: Must include executable and detached descriptor assertions.

criteria.conditions: Missing, malformed, latest, and duplicate versions fail closed.
criteria.evidence_method: Negative registry tests and source scan.
criteria.target: Registration is explicit, static, duplicate-free, and exact-versioned; no latest or auto-discovery.
criteria.validity_notes: No dynamic loading or marketplace behavior is in scope.

criteria.conditions: Capability registry adds no policy or approval authority.
criteria.evidence_method: Public harness and worker integration tests.
criteria.target: Every composed execution reaches the existing Runtime policy, approval, journal, audit, and telemetry path.
criteria.validity_notes: Must exercise factory and durable worker paths.

criteria.target: Input, output, schemas, and non-core origin data are bounded and fail closed when malformed, oversized, cyclic, or unsupported.
criteria.validity_notes: Known-bad values must not reach provider execution.

criteria.conditions: Fingerprint excludes executable function bodies and payloads.
criteria.target: One registry produces a deterministic descriptor fingerprint and rejects ambiguous or missing composition.
criteria.validity_notes: Registration ordering must not change the fingerprint.

criteria.target: Native, Skill, Plugin, knowledge, and simulated MCP origins use the same contract without granting authority.
criteria.validity_notes: Origin metadata must not bypass governance.

criteria.conditions: No network call or credential is permitted.
criteria.evidence_method: Optional adapter test and dependency scan.
criteria.target: MCP remains an optional simulated adapter; no network or MCP client dependency is required.
criteria.validity_notes: Absence of a client dependency is part of the claim.

criteria.conditions: Only implementation/provider identity and synthetic output vary.
criteria.target: Two provider implementations can be swapped without changing Runtime, policy, or approval wiring.
criteria.validity_notes: Both variants must use the same public factory.

criteria.conditions: No new persistence table or authority is introduced.
criteria.evidence_method: Existing regression plus composed capability path.
criteria.target: Existing effect journal and durable approval paths preserve replay, restart, and uncertain-effect semantics.
criteria.validity_notes: Controlled evidence does not qualify production exactly-once behavior.

criteria.conditions: Context is supplied by the governed Runtime.
criteria.target: Capability execution retains tenant, agent, and correlation scope and cannot cross tenant boundaries.
criteria.validity_notes: No provider may select tenant identity from payload.

criteria.target: At least 20 concurrent synthetic compositions remain deterministic and do not duplicate effects.
criteria.validity_notes: Results must include a duplicate-effect assertion.

criteria.conditions: No fallback to latest or unregistered implementation.
criteria.target: Unknown origin, version drift, invalid descriptor/result, unauthorized tool, and direct bypass attempts fail closed.
criteria.validity_notes: Direct ToolRegistry access must not create a second authority.

criteria.conditions: Consumer uses published harness exports and neutral contracts.
criteria.target: A second independent consumer can compose the registry through the public contract without deep imports.
criteria.validity_notes: No product package is allowed in the consumer path.

criteria.conditions: Evidence is current for the exact integrated candidate.
criteria.target: Current candidate digest, command results, skips, limitations, critic, sentinel, and report are linked.
criteria.validity_notes: Any source change invalidates prior candidate-bound evidence.

goal: Deliver a neutral external capability boundary through one explicit registry and one governed Runtime path, with controlled evidence and production remaining NO_GO.
